resources.string: Samvad is open source. The Android app is published under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 (AGPL-3.0). Anyone can read the code, check how the app works, and reuse it under the same licence.
The server code is in the same repository. It contains no passwords or secret keys.

• Signal Protocol library (libsignal), AGPL-3.0: end-to-end encryption of one-to-one chats
• LiveKit Android SDK, Apache-2.0: calls and meetings
• Firebase Android SDK, Apache-2.0, used with Google's Firebase terms: sign-in, database, files, notifications, app checks
• Google Play services (sign-in to Drive, code scanner), under Google's terms
• AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Room, DataStore, WorkManager, Biometric, Apache-2.0
• Coil, Apache-2.0: images and GIFs
• ZXing core, Apache-2.0: safety-number QR code
• Kotlin coroutines, Apache-2.0
• Plus Jakarta Sans font, SIL Open Font Licence 1.1
The full list and licence texts are in the NOTICE and LICENSE files in the repository.
